g1_verdict.result: G1 FAILED (final; confirmed again 11:30 JST 10/07 on live data)

g1_verdict.interpretation: Weakened H1/H2/H3/H4 alike: no lane produced a buyer action in 7 days. The failure is demand not reaching the company, not execution volume.
g1_verdict.root_cause: (1) The only active sales motion fishes in a pool that is thin and hostile to an honest AI-assisted solo seller (Coconala 公開依頼: ~110 seen, 5 qualified; 60–118 applicants per request; some buyers explicitly refuse AI; a 0-review seller loses on trust). (2) No owned distribution reaches buyers (X median 13 impressions, CTA reply 2–5 impressions, 0 clicks; stores/listings ~0 traffic). (3) Six days went into the operating system (mac-local autowake, profiles, permissions) before the sales motion could send its first proposal on 10/05 — the late start cost G1 directly.
g1_verdict.decision: G1 FAILED stands; the same strategy does not continue. Keep the 03:00 redesign (no thrash at +8h): concentrate on buyer-posted demand with widened supply, shrink everything that showed zero pull.
g1_verdict.resource_reallocation: Founder + mac-local time: ~80% → proposal motion (Coconala widened lane now; CrowdWorks the moment owner KYC lands), ~10% → measurement/backstops, ~10% → X at minimum (≤2/day, no new formats until the 10/08 verdict). Zero effort: note (stopped), Coconala/BOOTH listings, Stripe/Gumroad, Etsy, Zenn (live, untouched). No new agents (Art.6).
g1_verdict.next_action: mac-local: scan-1007pm 19:00 + inbox 2×/day + ≤5 proposals/day under PG-1 on the widened lane; answer any reply ≤12h. Founder: re-read Stripe/Coconala/X each fire; open the CrowdWorks lane (task h1-crowdworks-scan) the fire after owner KYC; 10/08 review applies the X and H3 triggers.
